info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Marjoram Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Marjoram Drill Detail Creation API enables users to add detailed specifications for marjoram drill products within the catalog. This functionality assists businesses in maintaining a comprehensive and organized product database. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who require accurate representations of their catalog offerings. The API streamlines the process of enriching product data, ensuring that stakeholders have access to the latest information for decision-making and reporting. Integration with other catalog management systems enhances overall product visibility and accessibility.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a detailed entry for the Marjoram drill, specifying various attributes and settings applicable for the operation. Ensure that all required fields in the request body are provided and accurate to successfully record the detail.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the details required for the Marjoram Drill operation. It encapsulates all necessary information that the endpoint expects to receive in order to perform the corresponding action successfully.

CreateCatalogMarjoramDrillDetailRequest.title: Marjoram Drill Request Body

marjoram_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Marjoram Drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Marjoram Drill requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the Marjoram Drill.
